references.text: Moses gathered the people and set before them the words of the Lord, and the people answered that they would do all that the Lord had said. This parallels Moses' gathering of Israel to hear the laws.
Moses told the people all the words and laws of the Lord, and the people answered unanimously that they would do all that the Lord had said. The same pattern of proclaiming laws to Israel.
Moses urges Israel to listen to the statutes and laws he teaches them, so that they may live and enter the land. The same introduction to law instruction.
Introduction to the commandments, statutes, and laws which the Lord commanded Moses to teach the people. Part of the same legislative context.
The famous Shema text beginning with 'Hear, O Israel!' - the same call to listen as in 5:1.
Command to gather the people so that they may hear and learn to fear the Lord and keep the words of the law. The same concept of gathering Israel to hear and learn.
Summary of the statutes and laws the Lord gave between himself and the children of Israel through Moses at Mount Sinai.
The exhortation to pay all the more attention to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away from it. A New Testament parallel to listening carefully to God's word.
